notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
Kambal's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Kambal's second ability triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.
